review_candidates.title: In-House Sales & Technical Bid Specialist (Egypt-Based) – Life Sciences & Laboratory Supplies
review_candidates.description: Location: Egypt (Remote / Hybrid / Office-based – specify your setup) Industry: Laboratory Consumables & Analytical Equipment Specializations: Microbiology | Molecular Biology | Chromatography | Fine Chemicals Are you a sales professional who speaks the language of science? Do you get frustrated when a bid is lost because the wrong catalog number was quoted, or because the technical specifications didn’t match the tender requirements? We are looking for a meticulous, technically-savvy In-House Sales Specialist to act as the bridge between our commercial team and our technical portfolio. This is not a standard customer service role. This is a strategic procurement-support role where your expertise in lab supplies directly impacts our win rate in tenders and RFQs. --- The Role: Based in Egypt, you will be the backbone of our bidding process. Your core mission is to select and match the correct items for customer proposals, ensuring every quotation we send is technically compliant, commercially viable, and competitively priced. Key Responsibilities: · Tender & RFQ Analysis: Review incoming tenders, purchase requests, and ITBs (Invitations to Bid) from clients across the MENA region. · Technical Sourcing: Identify the most suitable products from our portfolio (or external partners) that strictly meet the client’s technical specifications for Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Chromatography, and Fine Chemicals. · Cross-Reference: Accurately map competitor part numbers to our equivalent offerings to win "brand-specific" tenders. · Pricing Strategy: Collaborate with the procurement team to ensure competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins. · Quality Control: Verify that all items quoted are available, have correct lead times, and meet regulatory/quality standards. · Documentation: Prepare full technical/commercial offers for the sales team to present to clients. --- Who You Are (The Ideal Profile): We are looking for a scientist who transitioned into sales, or a sales professional with deep lab knowledge. · Experience: Minimum 3-5 years in a similar role (In-House Sales, Technical Support, or Bid Specialist) within the laboratory supplies, diagnostics, or pharmaceutical distribution sector. · Technical Knowledge: You must be comfortable reading product specifications for: · Microbiology (Media, cultures, identification kits). · Molecular Biology (PCR reagents, enzymes, nucleic acid extraction). · Chromatography (Columns, solvents, vials, standards). · Fine Chemicals (Reagents, buffers, high-purity solvents). · Soft Skills: · Zero-Tolerance for Errors: You triple-check part numbers before sending an offer. · Strategic Thinker: You don’t just “fill a list”; you analyze why a client chooses a specific brand and offer alternatives to save them money without compromising quality. · Fast-Paced: You can handle high volumes of RFQs during peak tender seasons without losing accuracy. --- Why Join Us? · Work with a leading supplier of laboratory solutions in the region. · Autonomy to structure the internal bidding workflow. · Competitive salary + performance-based incentives. · Be the go-to expert that the sales team relies on to win deals. --- How to Apply: Send your CV and a brief cover letter detailing your most complex tender win to : sslksajob@gmail.com Note: Only candidates with proven experience in the laboratory supply industry will be contacted. We are looking for a self-starter who takes ownership of their quotations. If you require constant hand-holding to check specifications, this role is not for you. We need someone who can stand behind their technical decisions

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur SRE AWS F/H
review_candidates.description: Avec près de 11 000 collaborateurs à travers le monde, nous accompagnons les entreprises dans leur transformation numérique. Nous imaginons et concrétisons leurs ambitions grâce aux possibilités infinies des plateformes digitales, pour faire évoluer leur culture et leur mode de travail, et créer de la valeur dans leurs organisations. Présent dans 18 pays d’Europe et du Moyen-Orient et fort de 25 ans d’expérience, nous mettons la technologie au service de l'Homme afin de construire un monde plus humain et plus durable. L’agence lyonnaise est composée de 350 collaborateurs répartis en communautés d’experts. Devoteam Lyon accompagne les DSI dans leur transformation digitale, avec un focus sur les nouvelles technologies comme le cloud (AWS, Microsoft, Google), l'intelligence artificielle, la cybersécurité, la data, et l'automatisation des processus métiers. Devoteam A Cloud aide ses clients à se transformer en véritables entreprises plateformes grâce à l’adoption du Cloud AWS, tout en participant à la construction d’une économie numérique plus durable. Notre ambition est de repousser les limites de l’innovation pour les organisations confrontées aux enjeux technologiques actuels, en tirant parti des plateformes cloud pour tester rapidement de nouvelles idées et innover de façon agile et optimisée. Pour développer l’activité AWS au sein de la Squad A cloud, nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Cloud AWS. Description Du Poste Vos Missions au Quotidien ☁️ Concevoir, automatiser et maintenir des infrastructures AWS robustes, scalables et sécurisées. Participer à des projets stratégiques : déploiement et optimisation de pipelines CI/CD, migration d’applications, modernisation d’environnements et mise en place de solutions innovantes. Garantir la fiabilité et la performance des systèmes en mettant en œuvre les bonnes pratiques SRE (monitoring, alerting, observabilité, optimisation des coûts). Collaborer avec les équipes projet et les développeurs, de la phase de design jusqu’à l’exploitation en production. Renforcer la culture DevOps chez nos clients en accompagnant la mise en place d’outils, de process et en favorisant le transfert de connaissances. Contribuer à la communauté AWS lyonnaise, en partageant ton expertise et en participant aux événements locaux. Qualifications Vos Atouts pour Réussir ✨ Vous disposez d’une solide expérience en exploitation et automatisation d’infrastructures AWS à grande échelle. Vous maîtrisez les principaux services AWS (EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, RDS, CloudWatch, Lambda, EKS, etc.) et savez les intégrer dans des environnements de production fiables et sécurisés. Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) et les outils de CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.). Vous appliquez au quotidien les bonnes pratiques SRE : monitoring, alerting, observabilité, optimisation des performances et des coûts. Vous avez une bonne compréhension de la sécurité cloud (IAM, compliance, best practices AWS Well-Architected Framework). Vous savez travailler en collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (dev, ops, architectes) et favoriser une culture DevOps. Vous aimez partager vos connaissances et contribuer à la montée en compétence des équipes. Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation supérieure en informatique (Bac+5) ou équivalent. Bonus : vous contribuez à la communauté (meetups, conférences, open source, articles) et restez à l’affût des dernières innovations AWS. Pourquoi nous rejoindre : Nous sommes une IA-Driven Company : Né lors des prémices de la révolution tech, Devoteam est le partenaire de confiance qui a accompagné ses clients vers l'évolution d'Internet, du Cloud, et désormais, de la révolution de l'IA. Pour cela, 100% de nos collaborateurs sont certifiés GenAI. Rejoindre Devoteam, c’est apprendre en continu. Avec 75% de collaborateurs certifiés, Devoteam est une Learning Company où l’apprentissage est au cœur de notre modèle. Avec 50 tribus d’expertise composées de leaders technologiques, nous collaborons avec les plus grands partenaires technologiques : Google, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow, Snowflake, et bien d’autres. You'll grow revenue by winning new clients, deepening existing relationships, and translating complex technical solutions into clear, compelling commercial proposals.   You don't need to have sold SCADA systems before. What matters is that you come from a technical sales background , ideally electrical engineering or renewable energy , and that you can learn our solutions quickly, explain them simply, and earn the trust of engineers, consultants, and decision-makers. Our technical team will support you on the specifics; we'll rely on you to own the customer relationship and the commercial outcome.   If you're technically curious, comfortable managing long sales cycles, and motivated by clean energy and smart infrastructure, this role is built for you. Own the full sales cycle and consistently meet or exceed monthly and annual targets.   Technical & Pre-Sales   Run technical consultations and pre-sales discussions, articulating system capabilities, integration needs, and value in terms the client understands.   Work closely with the engineering team so that every proposal is technically feasible and aligned with project scope and design standards.   Support the preparation of high-level system concepts and functional specifications for client review during the pre-sales phase.   Act as the primary point of contact from first inquiry through contract award, then hand over cleanly to the delivery team.   Client & Market Development   Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients, consultants, EPCs, and key stakeholders in the energy sector.   Track market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies, and feed insights back into our go-to-market approach.   Represent Affinity at exhibitions, industry forums, and client events to strengthen our presence and generate leads.   Support marketing efforts through project showcasing, lead generation, and input into company profiles and presentations.   Reporting & Coordination   Maintain accurate records of your pipeline, forecasts, targets, and client interactions using CRM tools. Support project kick-off and scope clarification to keep customer satisfaction high after the sale.  What You'll Bring   Education   Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mechatronics, Communications Engineering, or a related technical discipline.   Additional background in Business, Marketing, or Project Management is a plus.     Experience   Minimum 3 years in technical or B2B sales, business development, or pre-sales , ideally in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or industrial/energy systems.   A proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a technical selling environment.   Direct experience with SCADA, automation, PV solar, or BESS is a strong advantage but not required , we'll support the right candidate in building this knowledge.     Technical Understanding (advantage, and developed on the job)   Familiarity with power systems, control, and communications is valued: SCADA platforms, PLCs/HMIs, Power Plant Controllers, and protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, or IEC 61850.   Comfort reading and commenting on single-line diagrams, system architectures, and technical specifications.   A general grasp of Ethernet and TCP/IP networking as it relates to automation systems.   Where you don't yet have this depth, a genuine willingness and ability to learn it quickly is what counts.     Skills   Strong sales, negotiation, and persuasion skills.   The ability to translate technical concepts into simple, practical language for a commercial audience.   Confident presentation and proposal-writing skills.   Sharp analytical skills , able to read client needs, spot gaps, and propose tailored solutions.   Well organized, able to manage multiple opportunities under tight deadlines.   A collaborative approach, working comfortably alongside engineering, procurement, and project management.   Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems.     Languages   Fluency in Arabic and English (minimum High B2 / C1 level).     Other Requirements     Willingness to travel to client and project sites within Jordan and, as needed, the wider region.   A valid driver's license and willingness to use your own car for business travel (mileage/travel reimbursed per company policy).     Why Affinity   Work at the front edge of the region's clean-energy and smart-infrastructure transition.   Sell solutions you can stand behind, backed by a strong technical team.   A role with real ownership of client relationships and commercial outcomes, and clear targets to grow against.
